title: Sum Array
description: Write a function that returns the sum of all numbers in a vector. For example, given {1, 2, 3, 4, 5} the function should return 15.
instructions: Complete the sum_array function so it adds up every number in the vector and returns the total.
hints: Use a for loop to iterate through the vector.
Keep a running total and add each element to it.
Start your total at 0 before the loop begins.
